Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of recurrent palpitations.

Leon James is a 76-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism. He reports intermittent episodes of a racing, irregular heartbeat over the past several weeks, occurring both at rest and with activity and lasting several minutes. Episodes are sometimes accompanied by mild lightheadedness.

Please evaluate him for recurrent palpitations and advise on further assessment and management.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Daniel Pierce
